name: rody/gridly-design-overlay
description: A WordPress plugin for showing a development grid overlay.

scripts.dist: rm -rf /tmp/gridly-design-overlay-dist && mkdir -p /tmp/gridly-design-overlay-dist "/Users/rody/Desktop/Rody/rodyvdkar.nl/Overlay plugin" && rsync -a --exclude-from=.distignore ./ /tmp/gridly-design-overlay-dist/gridly-design-overlay/ && (cd /tmp/gridly-design-overlay-dist && zip -qr "/Users/rody/Desktop/Rody/rodyvdkar.nl/Overlay plugin/gridly-design-overlay.zip" gridly-design-overlay) && cp "/Users/rody/Desktop/Rody/rodyvdkar.nl/Overlay plugin/gridly-design-overlay.zip" "/Users/rody/Local Sites/wpgridoverlay/app/public/wp-content/gridly-design-overlay.zip" && unzip -l "/Users/rody/Desktop/Rody/rodyvdkar.nl/Overlay plugin/gridly-design-overlay.zip"
